jamie: Quick follow-up to the hosting/dedicated/private abstraction thread — we need to nail who owns retries, auth refresh, and observability sampling when a request crosses hosting boundaries (hosted -> private sidecar -> runtime). Thoughts?

priya: Agree. TL;DR: keep auth & retries close to caller. But observability traces should be correlated by control-plane trace id.

sam: We had a bug last week where hosted retried a request and private sidecar also retried -> double-execution. :grimacing: 

maria: Product concern: users expect idempotency when we failover to dedicated. We can't expose semantics that break customer requests.

jamie: Proposal: small handshake/state machine between control-plane gateway and private sidecar. Responsibilities:
- caller: ensure idempotency keys
- gateway: route and attach runtime-level trace + policy header
- sidecar/runtime: convert transient auth to local token and respond with explicit accept/fallback states

sam: Minimal handshake sketch:
```
Client -> Gateway : X-Trace, X-Idemp
Gateway -> Sidecar : HANDSHAKE {trace, idemp, policy}
Sidecar -> Gateway : HANDSHAKE-ACK {state: ACCEPTED | DEGRADED | REJECT, sink: region/variant}
Gateway -> Client : 200 + note OR 302 -> fallback
``` 

priya: If sidecar returns DEGRADED we should *not* retry automatically. Gateway should stream a partial response and call fallback policy async.

maria: How do we encode sampling/privacy? private sidecars must strip pii before sending telemetry to hosted. We need a defined header: X-Pii-Policy: strip|redact|none

jamie: Suggested config (routed at tenant level):
```
handshake:
  max_attempts: 2
  fallback_policy: [region, model-variant]
  pii_policy: strip
  observability: propagate_trace: true
```

sam: :+1: Also add a short TTL for transient tokens so sidecars can't be long-lived.

deploy-bot: deploy status: handshake-proxy v0.3 deployed to staging at 2025-06-12T14:03Z

priya: Next steps: I'll draft a tiny RFC with the state-machine, headers, and a few test-cases (double-retry, degraded semantics, pii strip). Can we get reviews from runtime & security?

jamie: @sam @maria please review. I'll include a small test harness simulating double-retry.

sam: Will do this afternoon.

maria: +1 from product, please include rollout caveats for Dedicated customers.

jamie: Thanks all. I'll post RFC link when ready.
